sections.changelog:
0.16.13

  • Add RentEGI MITS 5 property, floor plan, rent, deposit and availability syncing through the central API, with scheduled, manual and accelerated sync support.
  • Preserve saved inventory on failed or incomplete feeds, retain manual specials and media, and derive public availability from published units.
  • Require compatible Rent Fetch Core features for RentEGI while preserving settings and keeping other integrations available during updates.
  • Add shared property locks, Editor and Administrator manual-sync permissions, detailed diagnostics and one cache refresh at the end of full automatic syncs.
  • Requires Rent Fetch API 0.4.15 and Rent Fetch 0.39.15 for RentEGI. Deploy the API first.
